caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular piece of patterned fabric with a repeating design. The design consists of circular medallions, each containing a monochrome portrait of a man, surrounded by a red border adorned with white stars. The medallions are interspersed with green and blue leaves and red berry clusters. Between the medallions, there are images of an eagle with wings spread, colored in shades of black and white, clutching arrows in its talons. The background of the fabric is a light beige or off-white color, and all elements are illustrated with fine lines and filled with red, blue, green, black, and white hues. The entire patterned section is centrally placed on a larger, plain, off-white background.
title: Printed Cotton - Historical
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
